body:
CI-RS bounded publisher branch-creation clarification and source transition.

Root accepts the create-only CAS mechanism in proposal SHA2567be86c1ef2a8684f5e79e8e8c53404d3e307a98fdde889f3ce15675a890c61cb. Sole permitted lease is `--force-with-lease=refs/heads/release/module-<full-plan-sha256>:` with an EMPTY expected value, exactly one derived branch refspec, exact candidate SHA and canonical receiving HTTPS repository, `--porcelain --no-follow-tags`. It authorizes creation only. Existing refs must never be overwritten; existing exact candidate is reused after readback without another push. Ordinary --force, plus refspec, implicit/tracking/nonempty/duplicate leases, main/tag/other-ref leases, deletion and extra refspecs remain forbidden. Ordinary exact tag creation has no lease and uses its independently accepted tag target SHA. No protected-main permission changes.

Independent holder successor0e6ba5f4dde639c18036594a3d17d6b1e7de1a61 was fully reviewed and imported as c61a1ff85565374fbbc9dd11f6e1dfc95224f459, exact treee9114d3013f1d63531c71c19ecc42ed36f4134b9. All2064 manifest entries verified. Root repeated the exact shell entrypoint:7.383 seconds,1 RUN/0 PASS/1 FAIL/0 SKIP,52 prepared/ZERO SUT invocations. All four actual Git CAS controls and31 exact push-oracle controls completed: ordinary push demonstrated the ancestor race; the create-only lease and remote old-object check preserved the competing ref before/after advertisement; lawful creation and read-only resume worked. Root verified549 command capture pairs/1098 stream hashes,7 owned hook pairs and19 joined forge processes. Root also observed a separate readonly Go-cache TempDir cleanup failure after CAPABILITY_ABSENT; it is retained for bounded holder cleanup correction, not hidden or called semantic RED. Root review SHA25659ae4907d25127df227eb2df81f4892e22fcb5df8c2a85807465317241142a84.

Within the existing nine-path source authorization5718548000, the independent source worker may now implement this exact branch create-only operation and required typed readback: different observed ref => CONFLICT/EFFECT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT, preserve SHA and stop before PR; unavailable uncertain outcome => UNKNOWN, no duplicate retry. Historical e9dc holder and source contracts remain preserved; only this independently reviewed successor recognizes the finite create-only form.

Root also accepts the finite personal-identity/auth mechanism from proposal6d766920b1f8862f149991d816a350c340b676024b83307594ff234925addb90 and its corrected native URL sequence: owned receiving git init, add canonical origin, native get-url plus --push readback, then guarded fetch. The failed command-scoped remote hypothesis is not accepted. Candidate identity comes from the existing personal Git configuration without identity overrides; valid commit objects use the explicit logical max(producer/base commit-time)+1 metadata and native hash/object readback. Root independently rebuilt two identical objects and verified native fsck/config preservation; review2bf2cc5c934a12cf8761db4487330867ede8a8ab32b0563ef77b8524711b4a7f. Default credential config is used only for publisher identity and canonical transport; other candidate/consumer/pins isolation remains unchanged. Latest-compatible baseline must remain fresh after admission.

This permits bounded implementation, not publisher GREEN, complete D4, live release/tag/main delivery or issue closure. Public Go signed-checksum verification remains mandatory and has a separately authorized independent holder in preparation; API credential fallback remains under separate review.
